patterns: Dominant shape: 'largest import/export item' or 'largest partner/source/destination' single-fact questions; POL/crude = largest import is the stock answer (APPSC 2018).
Definitions of trade terms (entrepot trade, closed economy, free trade) asked directly, including by APPSC G2.
Policy milestones recur: SEZ policy April 2000, FTP targets (3.5% share by 2020, 2 trillion by 2030), first AEFC Pune 2021, rupee settlement via Vostro accounts.
Trade surplus years 1972-73 and 1976-77 and devaluation effect (exports cheaper, imports dearer) are evergreen traps.
App MCQs lean on 2024-25 percentage tables and economic theory (J-curve, Marshall-Lerner, GTT/NTT) more deeply than PYQs, which ask rank/identity rather than exact shares.
